notable_facts: Explicitly addresses a KNOWN CONFOUND up front: Part B of evaluate_socio_semantic_reality ('Doxa hoarding', MAX_MONOPOLY=0.85) penalizes U_prob row-max > 0.85 for the 4 semantic target_facets only when structural signal is itself spread (high entropy) -- so absence of purity witnesses among HIGH-degree entities in those 4 facets is confounded/uninformative, while absence among LOW-degree entities there, or anywhere in the 4 unconfounded facets (auth/affil/journ/art), is the real signal. The script reports witness degree specifically so this distinction can be read off directly.
This is the cited Tier-1 evidence that FINDINGS §18/rotation_feasibility_search.py's header describes as 'strong indirect evidence against reachable blending' motivating the Tier-2 direct test.
Cites the NMF identifiability literature directly in its header comment (Donoho & Stodden 2003; Arora et al. 2012; Huang, Sidiropoulos & Swami 2014's 'sufficiently scattered' condition).
